AUD.title: Central bank policy rates - Australia - Daily - End of period
AUD.compilation: From 2 Aug 1990 onwards: cash rate target; from 23 Jan 1990 to 1 Aug 1990: middle of the cash rate target range; from 7 Apr 1976 to 22 Jan 1990: interbank overnight cash rate.
AUD.supp_info_breaks: This rate can be considered the official policy rate as from 23 Jan 1990. Australia had a managed exchange rate regime prior to 1983, in an environment of capital controls. The RBA did not have an explicit target interest rate prior to 23 Jan 1990. The BIS publishes a representative rate for that period. Between  23 Jan 1990 and 31 Jul the middle of the cash rate target corridor is used.

CAD.title: Central bank policy rates - Canada - Daily - End of period
CAD.compilation: From 1 Jun 1994 onwards: Central Bank target, overnight rate; from 27 Jul 1960 to 31 May 1994: official bank rate.
CAD.supp_info_breaks: In Jun 1994 the Bank of Canada (BoC) began shifting emphasis from the bank rate to the target for the overnight rate as its key monetary policy instrument. In Feb 1999 the target for the overnight rate was defined as the midpoint of the band, or 25 basis points below the bank rate. In May 2001 the BoC began emphasizing the target as its key interest rate in its communications with the public.

CHF.title: Central bank policy rates - Switzerland - Daily - End of period
CHF.compilation: From 13 June 2019 onwards SNB Policy rate; From 1 Jan 2000 to 12 June 2019 mid-point of the SNB target range; from 1 Jan 1946 to 31 Dec 1999: discount rate.

EUR.title: Central bank policy rates - Euro area - Daily - End of period
EUR.compilation: From 18 Sep 2024 onwards: official central bank steering rate is the deposit facility rate, fixed rate; from 15 Oct 2008 to 17 Sep 2024: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate; from 28 Jun 2000 to 14 Oct 2008: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, minimum bid rate; from 5 Jan 1999 to 27 Jun 2000: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate.

GBP.title: Central bank policy rates - United Kingdom - Daily - End of period
GBP.compilation: From 3 Aug 2006 onwards: official bank rate; from 6 May 1997 to 2 Aug 2006: repo rate; from 20 Aug 1981 to 5 May 1997: minimum Bank of England Band 1 dealing rate; from 16 Oct 1972 to 19 Aug 1981: minimum lending rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 15 Oct 1972: bank rate.

JPY.title: Central bank policy rates - Japan - Daily - End of period
JPY.compilation: From 17 Jun 2026 onwards: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent; From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.75 percent; From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.50 percent; From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25% ; From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %; from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%. Short-term policy interest rate; from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate; from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%; from 19 Dec 2008 to 4 Oct 2010: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0. %; from 31 Oct 2008 to 18 Dec 2008: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.3%; before 30 Oct 2008, refer to https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL

NZD.title: Central bank policy rates - New Zealand - Daily - End of period
NZD.compilation: From 17 Mar 1999 onwards: Official market intervention representative rate, official cash rate; from Jan 1985 to 16 Mar 1999: overnight cash rate.
NZD.supp_info_breaks: This rate can be considered the official policy rate as from 17 Mar 1999.

USD.title: Central bank policy rates - United States - Daily - End of period
USD.compilation: From 19 Dec 1985 onwards: mid-point of the Federal Reserve target rate; from 1 Jul 1954 to 18 Dec 1985: US Fed Funds effective rate.

effective_date_rule: value on date d = last observation with obs_date <= d; no backward fill before first observation; no future publication used on an earlier date
